newsitem.title: USA: Harbor Federal sets stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Harbor Federal sets stock buyback.

text.p: Harbor Federal Savings Bank said Wednesday it plans to buy back up to five percent of its shares now that it has reorganized into the two-tier form of mutual holding company ownership.

The company said the Harbor Federal Savings Bank is now the wholly owned subsidiary of Harbor Florida Bancorp Inc, a Delaware corporation. Harbor Florida Bancorp Inc is the majority owned subsidiary of Harbor Financial MHC.
The company said each share of the bank's outstanding common stock was automatically converted into one share of Harbor Florida Bancorp Inc common stock.
Harbor Florida Bancorp Inc's common stock will trade on the Nasdaq national market under the symbol HARB on Thursday, June 26.
The company also said its board authorized the repurchase of up to 248,000 shares of its common stock, representing about five percent of the total outstanding common stock.
Repurchases will be conducted in the open market.
The repurchased stock will be used for general corporate purposes.
